reason: The slides are about letters, anchor points and measurements, and nothing in them tells me how a logo or a new look brings me a single extra guest or customer. I already have a designer I trust, so I would need a reason to change, not a pretty carousel.
objection: I cannot see the link between a measured letter and more bookings or sales for a business like mine. Design looks good in a feed, but I have seen plenty of nice work that did not move the numbers.
would_change_my_mind: A case study from a business like mine, showing the before and after numbers, such as more enquiries or bookings, not just the finished design.
